output.text:
I fixed the blur in `src/chart.js`, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't seen the result on a high-DPI screen yet.

**The change:** `drawChart` now:
- reads the chart's on-screen size from CSS (640×320)
- sets the canvas's internal pixel size to that size multiplied by `window.devicePixelRatio` (your screen's pixel density)
- scales the drawing to match, so all the existing layout code still works in normal 640×320 coordinates

On your laptop the bars and text should now be sharp. Your work monitor has a ratio of 1, so the chart is drawn exactly as before there.

**One case it doesn't cover:** zooming the browser (Ctrl +/–) or dragging the window to a screen with a different density after the page loads changes the pixel density. The chart only redraws when the page loads, so it would look soft again until you refresh. I can add a listener that redraws it automatically when that happens.
